verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst is documented as letting business users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL. Semantic Views separately let Snowflake store business metrics, entities and their relationships in the database. However, the evidence does not explicitly tie Cortex Analyst answers to Semantic Views or RBAC governance, and it says nothing about preventing hallucinated joins, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Cortex Analyst grounds answers in Semantic Views' defined relationships, evidence that RBAC governance applies to Analyst answers, any accuracy or anti-hallucination evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, business users can ask questions in natural language and get governed, semantically-grounded answers rather than hallucinated joins

citations.quote: With Cortex Analyst, business users can ask questions in natural language and receive direct answers without writing SQL.
You can define business metrics and model business entities and their relationships.
Available as a convenient REST API, Cortex Analyst can be seamlessly integrated into any application.
You can configure the MCP server to serve Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, and Cortex Agents as tools
